name: github-admin-companion
description: Local GitHub admin companion for repository About metadata and profile pin inspection using the authenticated GitHub CLI.

interface.longDescription: Manage GitHub repository descriptions, homepage URLs and exact topic sets through the authenticated GitHub CLI, and inspect profile pins. GitHub currently exposes profile pins as read-only through its public API, so pin changes remain a GitHub UI action.
interface.defaultPrompt: Audit and manage my GitHub repository About metadata, topics, homepage URLs, and profile pin state.
